notes.title: Hotfix: Rotate and Position Play Space with Trackpad
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I just added a feature that lets you use the Vive's trackpad to rotate and re-position the in-game play space to better accommodate different real world room setups.

Press left and right on the trackpad to rotate the world.  Press up and down on the trackpad to move the world forward or backward.

Have fun!
